ai_summary.key_headline: Rangnick's Gegenpress Put to the Test Against Resilient Jordanians

austria.philosophy: High-intensity vertical press and immediate counter-pressing.

jordan.philosophy: Deep low-block with quick transitions through Al-Taamari.

tactical_insights: Austria's high press will aim to choke Jordan's build-up play in their first World Cup appearance since 1998.
Jordan will rely heavily on Rennes winger Musa Al-Taamari's dribbling to bypass Austria's initial press.
Captain David Alaba's distribution and Sabitzer's late runs will be key to unlocking Jordan's compact block.
